trainer.dialogueBefore: Camper Curtis: A trainer takes a challenge wherever it finds him. Even in a tunnel!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Camper Curtis: Careful in caves. Wild Pokémon turn up anywhere in here, not only in grass.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Picnicker Diana: I made it all the way through the cave! Let's have a battle to celebrate!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Picnicker Diana: Well... I suppose losing is something to remember the day by, too.
